digest.component_or_area: agent tool hooks / bash tool configuration
propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a non-blocking reminder when grep/rg/egrep/fgrep is invoked, recommending Serena's symbol tools as the preferred alternative.
The hook trigger must match grep-family commands by plain string matching only, without pattern classification or path heuristics.
The reminder message must be 2-3 lines, name find_referencing_symbols, and document the valid grep use cases (string literals and line numbers) so it never misleads.
The hook must emit JSON with additionalContext and omit permissionDecision to remain non-blocking and not suppress the permission prompt.
An automated test must verify the hook fires on grep/rg commands and not on non-grep commands, and never exits non-zero.
The settings.json merge must preserve the existing env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH entry from story C.
